items.headline: Europe's first trophy is up for grabs today — PSG vs Aston Villa
items.body: The new European season kicks off with silverware: Champions League winners PSG take on Europa League winners Aston Villa in the UEFA Super Cup in Salzburg (3pm ET, CBS/Paramount+). It's Villa's first Super Cup in 44 years — they last played in it, and won it, back in 1982.
items.say: The European season's back today — PSG and Aston Villa are playing for the Super Cup. Villa haven't been in this thing since 1982.

items.headline: The Counter-Strike showdown everyone's waited for starts today at the Esports World Cup
items.body: The CS2 event at the Esports World Cup tips off today in Paris — 32 teams, a record $2M pool, and all the giants in one bracket: Vitality, MOUZ, FaZe, Falcons, NAVI and defending EWC champs The MongolZ, plus underdogs 100 Thieves. Group stage runs through Aug 16, and every match streams free.
items.say: The big Counter-Strike event at the Esports World Cup starts today — Vitality, FaZe, all the top teams. It's free to watch. You following any of it?

items.headline: Deadline day is coming — and Chelsea are outspending the planet
items.body: The summer window shuts Sept 1, and the spending is wild: Chelsea have brought in 11 players for north of €400m, more than any club on earth, while Tottenham dropped big money on Sandro Tonali and Arsenal added Bruno Guimarães. Three weeks of frantic dealing left before the music stops.
items.say: The transfer window shuts in a few weeks and it's been nuts — Chelsea have spent over €400 million on eleven players. You keep up with the transfer stuff?

items.headline: The two best players in the world are in a dead heat — and the Lynx just made a statement
items.body: The WNBA MVP race is down to A'ja Wilson and Napheesa Collier, and Collier's league-leading Lynx (26-7, best record in the league) just handled Wilson's Aces 98-87, with rookie Olivia Miles dropping 26. Wilson answered days later with her 17th double-double. It's the best rivalry in the sport right now.
items.say: The WNBA MVP thing is basically A'ja Wilson vs Napheesa Collier, and Collier's Lynx just beat A'ja's Aces. Best league in sports right now. You been watching?

links.text: Recap · Miles & Collier lead the Lynx

items.headline: The Yankees might get their MVP back for the stretch run — Aaron Judge is ramping up
items.body: Big news in the Bronx: Aaron Judge, sidelined since late May with a broken rib, has been cleared to start running and lifting again and says he'll return this season. Best guess is a September comeback right as the playoff race heats up — a scary thought for the rest of the league.
items.say: Sounds like Aaron Judge is close to coming back for the Yankees' playoff push. Imagine adding the MVP back in September. You following the pennant races?

links.text: Judge cleared for light activity, eyeing a return

items.headline: The surprise movie of the summer? Anne Hathaway fights dinosaurs on Friday
items.body: Warner Bros.' wild sci-fi swing 'The End of Oak Street' opens Friday, with Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor as suburban parents whose whole neighborhood gets yanked into a dino-filled unknown. Early reactions are raving — one memorable bit has Hathaway blasting a T-Rex with a shotgun. Reviewers are calling it the biggest surprise of the summer.
items.say: There's a new movie Friday where Anne Hathaway shotguns a T-Rex — critics are saying it's the surprise of the summer. Looks like a blast. You up for it?

items.headline: Nolan's 'Odyssey' is now his biggest movie ever — and the summer just crossed $4 billion
items.body: Christopher Nolan's epic 'The Odyssey,' with Matt Damon as Odysseus, has sailed past $1.1 billion to become the highest-grossing film of Nolan's career — and the biggest IMAX release ever. Paired with Spider-Man's monster run, it helped push the summer box office over $4 billion, only the second time that's happened since the pandemic.
items.say: Nolan's Odyssey is now the biggest movie he's ever made — the whole summer just crossed four billion dollars. Movies are officially back. You catch it in IMAX?

items.headline: Becky G goes back to her roots — new album 'Baraja Bendita' drops Friday
items.body: Becky G returns Friday with her fifth album, 'Baraja Bendita' ("Blessed Deck of Cards") — a 17-track record she's called a 'reverse crossover' that leans back into her rap roots while weaving in her Latin heritage. The single 'Patrona' — as in 'female boss' — has set the tone.
items.say: Becky G's got a new album Friday — she's going back to rapping on this one. That 'Patrona' single goes hard. You into her stuff?

items.headline: Afrobeats' brightest star is back — Ayra Starr's 'Starr Girl' arrives Friday
items.body: Nigerian superstar Ayra Starr — the Grammy-nominated voice behind 'Rush' and 'Commas' — releases her third album 'Starr Girl' on Friday. The lead single 'Tornado' kicked off the era with a slick video and a buzzy Tiny Desk performance. One for the end-of-summer playlist.
items.say: Ayra Starr has a new album out Friday — she's that Afrobeats singer who did 'Rush.' Perfect summer-playlist stuff. You come across her yet?
